description:
Yair Neugeboren Sr. Product Line Manager - Oscilloquartz
Anil Reddy VP gLOBAL Business Development - Oscilloquartz

  
The talk will discuss the evolution of a timecard as a resilient A-PNT custom solution. 
I will show how the OCP-TAP based Timecard design  can support resilient  solutions, including multi-receivers design, including a combination of GNSS and LEO based receivers. This design of a TC can meet and  support Assured PNT  resiliece level of 5 as specificed in IEEE p1952, and combined with anti-spoofing  capabilities such as Galileo OSNMA.
The talk will also present real data perfomance from field testing deploying an OCP-TAP based timecard, and demonstrate how this architecture can turn a COTS server into a PRTC-B resilient device with minimal integration effort (e.g. PTM performance when comparing the timecards PLL (PHC) to the system clock on the Servers CPU and to other NICs PHC on the same server).

lastly I will discuss how different verticals such as finance-enterprise-mobile-ADG  can use this Timecard design to meet their unique demands and topologies
